label: D-Link DGS-1210-52
description: D-Link DGS-1210-52 (Rev F) smart managed switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 4x 1G RJ45/SFP combo ports, 104 Gbps switching capacity, 77.4 Mpps, fanless 1U.

fabric.note: 104 Gbps switching capacity and 77.4 Mpps maximum 64-byte forwarding rate for the DGS-1210-52, from the DGS-1210 Series Rev F datasheet specification table (https://www.dlink.com/us/en/-/media/business_products/dgs/dgs-1210/datasheet/dgs1210seriesrevfdatasheet211enus.pdf). 52 ports x 2 Gbps full duplex, so an RJ45/SFP combo pair counts once whichever medium is in use.

notes: Ports, per the DGS-1210 Series Rev F datasheet (hardware Rev. F, 2.11 EN US, 05-SEP-2018): 48 x 10/100/1000BASE-T plus 4 x 10/100/1000 or 100/1000 SFP combo ports (one port, two cages, one medium at a time). 8K MAC entries, 256 static MAC entries, 12 Mbits packet buffer, DDR3 128 MB CPU memory, 32 MB flash, 256 static VLAN groups (VID 1-4094), 802.1D/802.1w/802.1s STP, 802.3ad LACP (8 groups of up to 8 ports), jumbo frames to 10,000 bytes, and 124 IPv4 / 50 IPv6 static routes over 4 IP interfaces - static routing, not a routing protocol, which is what puts this in the L3-lite class. Management is web GUI, compact CLI over Telnet, SNMP v1/v2c/v3 and D-Link Network Assistant; no model in the line has a serial console port (the console row in the datasheet is an LED, not a port). Dual software images and dual configuration files. Fanless (0 dB(A), Fans: No), 440 x 210 x 44 mm, 3.46 kg, 34.85 W at 100 V. Unusually for 48 copper ports the datasheet gives Fans: No and 0 dB(A). 104 Gbps = 52 ports x 2 Gbps full duplex, and the 48-port models carry a 12 Mbits packet buffer against 4.1 Mbits on the rest of the line. Source: https://www.dlink.com/us/en/-/media/business_products/dgs/dgs-1210/datasheet/dgs1210seriesrevfdatasheet211enus.pdf
